correctness.rationale: Exact count identities yield strict p0 and q0 barriers; positivity ensures N approaches K exponentially. Resource log odds then yield all three long-time regimes. Holding rich-state payoffs fixed, a fast-time family of depleted matrices approximates any constant-row terminal share with a remaining-capacity tail bound, and continuity gives exact attainment. The code verifies symbolic identities and boundary examples but does not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The originating paper's central phenomenon is payoff- and initial-state-dependent resource collapse versus recovery. The new theorem supplies a sharp complete phase trichotomy determined only by initially occupied capacity and the resource feedback threshold, and proves all three fates constructively reachable while the rich-resource payoff game remains unchanged. This structurally separates unavoidable initial-density outcomes from genuine game-dependent bistability, including a nongeneric interior resource endpoint; it is not a gratuitous parameter slice.
